On iPhone with iOS 17 or later, calculator, unit conversion, countdown, coin flip, dice, and kinship can stay on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Countdown ticks for the last 8 hours. Tap to return with the result. On iOS 18, Apple Watch and CarPlay show an icon and one line.

Widgets, 21

Fourteen also fit the Lock Screen. New small and large sizes do not move medium widgets you already placed. World clock, countdown, lunar calendar, BMI, mortgage, compound interest, and temperature gain a small or large size. Discount, tip split, and fuel cost gain small. Date math gains large.

Details

English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. Up to 4 Home Screen quick actions, 12 alternate icons, and 12 accent colors. Search the menu and change its grid columns. Tap a result to copy it. iOS 15 or later. Widgets and Live Activities need iOS 17. Without Mail, feedback still copies the address and a short diagnostic note.

Privacy

No ads and no tracking. A thank-you tip is optional. Nearly every tool works offline. Network requests, the browser, and file download go online only when you use them.

iConverter is meant to be the tool you open every day.

name: RakugakiAR
description:
"RakugakiAR" is a make-your-dream-come-true app that brings life to your doodle! Whether it's on a notebook, a whiteboard, or anywhere, this app scans the scribble you've drawn and brings it to life. The doodle will have its own life and walkabout in the AR environment on your smartphone. Feed them, poke them, play with them any way you want!

Whether you are an individual or a corporation, please refrain from using this application for profit or any other benefits, directly or indirectly, without our consent, including amusement events. If you wish to use this application, please contact hello@whatever.co for more information.

name: AGAIN. Rehearsal Notes
description:
AGAIN. is the rehearsal app that remembers why the band stopped.

You run the tune. Somebody stops it. "Bass, you're early on the bridge — verse two is four bars, not eight." Everyone nods. Next week nobody remembers. AGAIN. does.

PUT THE PHONE WHERE IT CAN HEAR THE ROOM
Tap Record and play. Tell the band you're recording. AGAIN. keeps going with the screen off, as long as the rehearsal runs. Or import a recording you already made.

IT FINDS EVERY STOP
On-device sound analysis tells music from talking. Each time the band stops to talk, that stop becomes a rehearsal letter — A, B, C — like the boxed letters in a score.

IT WRITES THE NOTES
What was said after each stop is transcribed on your iPhone and turned into short notes: who it's for, which song, what kind of fix (tempo, entrance, ending, arrangement, dynamics, sound, pitch, lyrics). Wrong? Edit any note, or write your own.

▶ THE 15 SECONDS BEFORE
Every stop and every note has a play button that plays the music right before the band stopped. No scrubbing. Everyone hears the spot.

MORE THAN ONE BAND, MORE THAN ONE SETLIST
Play in a band, a choir and a trio? Tap the band's name to switch. Each band keeps its own players, setlists, rehearsals and notes. Give a band as many setlists as it needs (Sunday service, the wedding, the club set) and pick one before you record: its songs are the ones you tap while you play.

BY SONG, BY PLAYER, BY WORD
Songs: every note on each tune, across rehearsals. Players: each musician's list, ready to send. Search: notes and full transcripts.

SEND THE NOTES TO THE BAND
Share a whole rehearsal's notes, or one stop's, to a text, an email or the group chat. Each musician's list has its own Send.

YOURS, ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No ads. No servers. Recordings, transcripts and notes stay on your iPhone. Speech recognition and note-writing run on device.

AGAIN. records other people's voices. Always tell the room you're recording and follow the recording laws where you play.

name: TurboScan™ Pro: PDF scanner
description:
TurboScan turns your iPhone into a full-featured and powerful scanner for documents, receipts, books, photos, whiteboards, and more. You can quickly and accurately scan your multipage documents in high quality PDFs or JPEGs, name, organize and send them anywhere. 

• Featured in The NY Times, CNN Money and The Telegraph.
• “Absolutely the best... I've tried other scanner apps and this one is the only way to go. Never going back to the other apps… TurboScan sets the standard for scanning apps.” - User review.
• “…Would recommend this flawless and incredibly useful and perfectly executed app” - User review.

TurboScan uses advanced and fast algorithms to accurately detect document edges, straighten them (correct perspective), eliminate shadows and set a perfect contrast for black on white text. Color and photo modes are also available.

TurboScan boasts a powerful yet easy to use interface. Our handy "Email to myself" feature lets you quickly send documents with one tap.

TurboScan also offers SureScan, our proprietary scanning mode for sharper scans (especially useful in low-light conditions.) SureScan automatically takes three pictures of the same document, giving you a guaranteed perfect result every time.

We do not collect any data from TurboScan and all scanning happens on your iPhone. The confidentiality of your data is never compromised. 

TURBOSCAN FEATURES: 
• Automatic document detection and capture with perspective correction
• Features SureScan for the sharpest scans
• Document naming, folder organization and smart search
• “Email to myself” feature for quick, regular emails
• Add and reorder pages at any time
• Arrange multiple receipts or cards on a single PDF page for printing, easy viewing, etc.
• Send faxes using our Turbo Fax app
• Easily email & message documents or separate pages as PDF & JPEG
• Save documents or pages to Photos
• Face/Touch ID & passcode lock for increased security
• Upload, auto-upload or backup documents to iCloud Drive
• Open PDFs or JPEGs in Google Drive and other PDF cloud apps
• Combine scans via Merge or copy & paste separate pages
• Conveniently AirDrop documents to your Mac and other devices  
• Print documents via AirPrint
• Ultra-fast scanning (under 3 seconds per page) 
• Features VoiceOver for visually impaired users
• We do not collect any user data in TurboScan


TIPS ON SCANNING 
• Make sure your document is flat. 
• Use flash in low light conditions, but avoid glare with glossy documents.


We support Ukraine.

We're constantly improving TurboScan, and we value our customers' opinions and feedback. Please email us at  support@turboscanapp.com with any questions or suggestions. Thank you!

name: Strip Designer
description:
Create amazing comic books with your photos and share with friends and family. Tell exciting stories with balloons, stickers, drawings, and warped 3D lettering. Strip Designer offers the complete comic creation experience on iOS and macOS. 


And no in-app purchases -- Everything is included! 

You'll begin by selecting one of the many included comic book page templates or create your own custom layout. 

Next, you'll add photos from the camera, your album, or create a drawing. Apply filters, or even paint on and mask your photos for atmosphere, style and retouching.

Add balloons and text anywhere you want and in any direction and size. Play with the colors and fonts until you get the perfect look.

Add stickers like "Boom", "Splash", or "Bang" to spice up the action -- Even create your own library using photos from your photo-album and the built-in masking and drawing tools.

Use 3D warped text with thick borders and gradient color-fill to give your comic the extra super-hero feel. Download and add additional free fonts easily within the app, to give your text a unique look!

While you work, you can freely pan and zoom to control even tiny details.

Once you have finished your masterpiece you can save it to your photo album or share it with your friends. Use PDF to share entire comic books in high-quality.

-- All from within Strip Designer.

Key Features:
• More than a 100 page templates with 1 to 9 photo cells 
• Multipage books
• Create your own panel layout with up-to 12 cells or use one of the standard layouts
• Many balloon types with customizable tails and heads
• Balloons can have multiple tails and be combined
• Flexible text options with per-letter colors and fonts
• Adjust ballon size, rotation, color, and transparency
• Add text (3D, warped, and perspective) for a superhero vibe
• Use any iOS font or install additional fonts for unique touch
• More than 150 stickers to insert for additional impact
• Page effects to give your pages old look
• Dropbox and WebDAV download/upload support
• Export to PDF to create real comic books 
• Import PDFs  (for both cells and custom stickers)
• Control scale, position, and rotation of photos
• Integrated drawing and masking tools to create your own drawings, paint on photos, or make your own stickers
• Auto mask and feather photos (to remove background)
• Many different cell styles
• Photo filters
• Fluidly pan and zoom to manage even the smallest details
• Insert maps for additional context
• iCloud sync across devices
• Support for iOS's third party document providers
• Layers view to lock or reorder layers
• Shared iPad (for education) setup through MDM configuration


No in-app purchases -- Everything is included!


- What the reviewers say -
"Strip Designer is worth every penny it costs, and then some. I would pay a couple more bucks for Lifestrips. It's stable, it's easy, it's fun, and for all that I couldn't come up with anything witty for my comic text, I love the look of my comics. Someone with a better imagination than I apparently have could really do fabulous things with this app. I rate it a solid five stars out of five.", Pamela Flora, iPhoneography
- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
"We were simply blown away by this application and the detail that has gone into the editing options and templates. We enjoyed the fact that a comic can be created very easily with photos and simple text effects, however there is real opportunities to really drill down into the editing options where the user can explore the apps true potential. There are many comic strip applications available on the Appstore but this is by far one of the best and great value for money. This app comes highly recommended by The Educational Appstore.", - See more at: http://www.educationalappstore.com/app/strip-designer#sthash.2KqjbU5Q.dpuf"
--------------------------

name: Voice Analyst: Pitch & Volume
description:
See your pitch and volume live as you speak — record, measure, and track your voice for speech therapy, voice training, and singing.

Voice Analyst is used in speech and language therapy clinics, research centres, universities and homes in more than 180 countries, with over 12 million recordings made.

Winner of the Digital Health Award (Medilink SW Healthcare Innovation).

Listed in the Parkinson's UK tech guide:
https://techguide.parkinsons.org.uk/catalogue/voice-analyst

One purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscriptions.

MEASURE YOUR VOICE
• Watch live graphs of your pitch (in hertz or musical notes) and volume as you speak or sing.
• Record your voice and play it back alongside its pitch and volume traces.
• See statistics for any recording, or any part of it: minimum, maximum, average and range for both pitch and volume.
• Set pitch and volume targets and see instantly when your voice is inside them.
• Zoom in on any part of a recording to analyse it in detail, and save any portion.
• Split View and multitasking support on iPad.

MADE FOR SPEECH THERAPY
• Practise between appointments with the targets your speech and language therapist sets — including the loudness targets used in programmes such as LSVT LOUD for Parkinson's.
• Track progress over time with saved recordings and statistics.
• Use it in clinic, at home, or in remote telehealth sessions.

SHARE WITH YOUR THERAPIST
• Email recordings and statistics to your speech and language therapist, or share by messaging and AirDrop.
• Save recordings to your device, or to iCloud, Dropbox and other cloud storage.
• Copy statistics into spreadsheets for records, reports and research.

WHO USES VOICE ANALYST
• Speech and language therapists (SLTs) measuring clients' pitch and loudness, in clinic and via telehealth.
• People in voice therapy — for Parkinson's disease, stroke, brain injury, dysarthria, vocal fold palsy, muscle tension dysphonia and other voice difficulties.
• Transgender and non-binary people training their voice with clear pitch feedback.
• Singers, actors, teachers and presenters monitoring and developing their voice.
• Researchers and students measuring voice objectively.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your recordings stay on your device unless you choose to share them.
• Nothing is uploaded to our servers — clinicians stay in control of client recordings.
• GDPR compliant — no personal data is collected.
• Works offline — record and analyse anywhere.

WHAT USERS SAY
"Fantastically easy to see where your pitch is, to set target ranges, to make and analyze recordings, and to export and import recordings. I can't imagine working on my voice without this app."

"I've been using Voice Analyst with my transgender clients. It is incredibly user friendly and provides great visual readings of frequency as well as an instant analysis of pitch range and mean. My clients can use it in session and some have downloaded it to work with at home."

"Love this app. So simple to use yet it packs all the technology needed to make it easy for me to monitor and motivate myself."

Voice Analyst is not a medical device — it measures and records your voice; it does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you are concerned about the quality of your voice, see your doctor and ask for a referral to an Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) specialist.

Questions or ideas? Email support@speechtools.co — we would be delighted to hear from you.

name: 2Do: To Do List & Task Manager
description:
"2Do adapts to my needs, not the other way around. 2Do gets me." — MacStories

2Do is a to do list, task manager and daily planner in one, with a simple, fluid interface wrapped around a deep and flexible set of features. Keep a quick checklist, run a full GTD® system, or anything in between: there is no wrong way to use 2Do, and it never forces a methodology on you.

One-time purchase. No subscription, no account to create, no strings attached.

TYPE IT THE WAY YOU'D SAY IT
• New: natural language input. Type "Call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm #health" and 2Do fills in the due date, time and tag as you type
• It reads dates, times, repeats, alerts, durations, priorities, tags, lists and saved locations, in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Russian

CAPTURE ANYTHING, FAST
• Quick Add: touch and hold [+] and file task after task, with dates, tags and lists as you type
• Siri & Shortcuts: add tasks by voice, or wire 2Do into routines that do the whole job
• Widgets, Lock Screen and Control Center, so capture never waits for the app
• Mail to 2Do: your device gets a private email address, and anything you send it lands as a task, checklist and all
• A GTD® Inbox for everything not yet sorted

SIMPLE TASKS, OR AS MUCH MORE AS YOU NEED
• Start with a task, grow it into a checklist or a project with sub-tasks
• Notes in Markdown, styled as you type, with links collected for you
• Flexible repeats, start dates that hide tasks until they matter, durations, and actions that make the next call or message one tap away
• Attach images and voice notes

SMART LISTS: SAVED SEARCHES WITH SUPERPOWERS
• Search across titles, notes, tags and dates; sounds-like matching finds it even when you can't spell it
• Save any search as a one-tap view: your weekly review, stalled projects, errands nearby
• Focus filter: set a rule per list and one tap hides everything that can wait

TAGS THAT SORT EVERYTHING
• One tap on a tag filters your day to that context; Tag Groups keep big collections tidy
• Pause a tag and every task carrying it steps out of view, hidden, not deleted, until you're ready

NEVER MISS A THING
• Stack multiple alerts on a task and let 2Do nag until it's done
• On iOS 26.1 and later, an alert can ring like a Clock alarm: full screen, through Silent mode, until you answer
• Nearby: location reminders that fire when you're close enough to actually do the task
• See your calendar events right above your tasks, so plans never collide

SYNC YOUR WAY
Most apps decide where your data lives. 2Do thinks that's your call:
• iCloud: uses the account already on your device; syncs tasks, Smart Lists, tags, groups and attachments
• Apple Reminders: your tasks live in Reminders too, so Siri and everything that reads Reminders can see them
• Todoist: connect your account and run your Todoist projects right inside 2Do
• Dropbox, Toodledo, Fastmail, or any CalDAV server you trust, including one you run yourself
• When two devices meet, 2Do can merge them instead of making you pick a winner
• 2Do for Mac is available separately, so your lists follow you to the desktop

MADE FOR ONE HAND
• Slide between your lists, tasks and a utility panel with Tags, Nearby and Calendar Events; one thumb runs all three
• Pinch to zoom between three levels of detail
• Quick Open: type a few letters, land on any task or list
• Batch edit and drag & drop: defer, tag or move a whole stack of tasks in one go

YOURS, PRIVATELY
• Lock individual lists or the whole app
• Automatic backups, with single-list restore for the day something goes wrong
• Share lists over Wi-Fi with other 2Do users nearby, no cloud in between
• Independent light and dark themes
• Apple Watch app with complications

2Do has been refined over years of careful work, with feedback from students, parents, professionals and lifelong list-keepers along the way. Use it as a simple list, or push it into full GTD® territory. Either way, it's ready.

name: HRV4Training
description:
The first scientifically validated Heart Rate Variability (HRV) app. HRV4Training provides HRV based insights to help you quantify stress,
better balance training and lifestyle, and improve performance. HRV4Training does not require a heart rate monitor, since it can accurately assess your HRV using the phone's camera. 

HRV4Training also works with Apple Watch, the Oura ring and all compatible Bluetooth SMART sensors.

HRV4Training is also the first app that goes beyond simple measurements and provides insights on:
1) acute or day to day HRV changes in response to different stressors (alcohol, travel, sick days, training, menstruation, etc.) 
2) long term multi-parameter trends to look at the big picture 
3) correlations between physiological measurements and annotations 
4) training load analysis, fitness, fatigue, readiness to perform and injury risk 
5) VO2max estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts
6) Training Polarization analysis (or 80/20) 
7) Lactate Threshold Estimation for runners linking the app to Strava or TrainingPeaks and using a heart rate monitor during their workouts
8) Weekly and monthly summaries to track progress. 

All data is processed inside the app in order to provide you with actionable interpretations that can help optimizing your training plan and performance.

Supported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 5, 5S, 6, 6S, 6+, 6S+, SE, 7, 7+, 8, 8+, X, XS, XS Max, XR, 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro Max, 12 mini, 12, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max, 13 mini, 13, 13 Pro, 13 Pro Max, 14, 14 Plus, 14 Max, 14 Pro, 15, 15 Max, 15 Pro, 16, 16 Max, 16 Pro

Currently unsupported devices for the camera measurement: iPhones 4S, iPads and iPods - These devices require a chest strap.

Other features: 
- HRV-based advice helps you to adapt your trainings based on objective measures of recovery
- TAGS: lets you tag your sleep, mental energy, muscle fatigue, stress and all other parameters that can help you understand what is influencing your physical condition and physiological stress
- Works with Bluetooth SMART heart rate monitors (a Polar H7 is recommended) or simply your phone's Camera
- Integrates with the Health app (writes heart rate, and sleep, read sleep time)
- Configurable test (single or orthostatic, choose test duration between 1, 3 or 5 minutes)
- Extracts and stores the following features while lying down and/or standing: heart rate, mean of beat-to-beat intervals (AVNN), standard deviation of beat-to-beat intervals (SDNN), square root of the mean squared difference of successive R-Rs (rMSSD), number of pairs of successive R-Rs that differ by more than 50 ms (pNN50), low frequency power (LF, 0.04-0.15 Hz), high frequency power (HF, 0.15-0.40 Hz)
- Shows the PPG signal view to ensure signal quality during the test if the camera is used instead of a bluetooth SMART sensor
- HRV4T Recovery Points to provide a single, straightforward metric to analyze your physical condition
- Population summaries and people like you comparisons to put your data into perspective
- Analysis of compliance and consistency 
- Data export via email or Dropbox
- Integrates with TrainingPeaks, Oura, Strava and Coros

HRV4Training requires to register an account with your email address, so that your data can be backed up safely and retrieved in case anything happens (app issue, changing phone, etc.).

HRV4Training does not provide medical advice. It is intended for informational purposes only. Consult a medical professional before making health or lifestyle decisions.

Please find an overview of the relevant scientific literature in our guide, here: https://marcoaltini.substack.com/p/the-ultimate-guide-to-heart-rate

name: Al Quran Translation

name: Solocator - GPS Field Camera
description:
Solocator – The GPS Camera for Fieldwork and Photo Proof evidence. Overlay and stamp photos with location, direction, altitude, date & time taken. With the Industry Pack (in-app purchase), capture field notes including project name, photo description, company or username, and company logo.
Solocator is trusted by professionals, government agencies, and industries worldwide for reliable photo documentation.

TAILOR OVERLAY INFORMATION TO YOUR NEEDS
Capture & stamp on your photos:

+ UTM/MGRS coordinates (Industry Pack)

EDITABLE NOTES OVERLAY

WATERMARK LOGO

CUSTOM EXPORT FILENAME
Define your photo export filename from a selection of fields: Project Name, Description, Watermark, Street Address, Date/Time, Number#, Custom text field, Photo type (original/stamped), and Coordinates (DD.dddddd, UTM, UTM Bands, MGRS). 

AUTOSAVE OR EXPORT PHOTOS TO CLOUD STORAGE
Autosave original and stamped photos to Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive (Personal & For Business), including SharePoint Sites and Teams. You can also save photos in date or project name subfolders automatically.

PHOTO DATA in KML, KMZ & CSV
Along with photos, email or export photo data and notes in KML, KMZ or CSV formats. Both email and export buttons are customisable to suit your data requirements.

STREET ADDRESS & UTM/MGRS
Add street address to your overlay or use UTM/, UTM Bands & MGRS coordinate formats.

BATCH EDIT NOTES & OVERLAY FIELDS
Select photos from the library and edit Project Name, Description & Watermark fields in one go.

TRACK PHOTOS IN MAP VIEW
View photos by direction, the distance between photos, area of photos taken and distance to your added markers via imported KML files or dropped pins.

REFINE & LOCK GPS LOCATION
Ideal for those working in and around buildings; to improve your GPS location. You can also use it to lock the asset position you're photographing.

COMPACT VIEW

name: Dominos Pizza
description:
This is an official mobile ordering app of Domino’s Pizza India. Now get your cheesy meals with incredible deals, only in 30 minutes!

Looking to order food online? Well, it better be Domino’s Pizza!
If you’re ordering Domino’s pizza online in India, Sri Lanka, or Bangladesh, get treated with delicious piping-hot pizzas, thanks to our extensive pizza delivery network available across the countries.

name: Telegram Messenger
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: CarTV - M3U IPTV Player & Cast
description:
CarTV is a lightweight M3U / M3U8 playlist tool, built for watching on the road.

SCREEN MIRRORING
- Put your whole iPhone screen on the car display: works with any app, even ones without a Cast button
- Open any app and it shows up on the car screen exactly as on your phone
- One tap on the Cast to Car tab to start

WHAT IT DOES
All you need is an M3U or M3U8 link. CarTV parses it, sorts the entries into the groups defined in your playlist, and plays them. No account, no sign-in, nothing to configure.

FORMATS AND PLAYBACK
- M3U and M3U8 playlists
- HLS and standard HTTP streams
- Hardware-accelerated decoding, with a software decoder as fallback for MKV, HEVC and DTS
- Embedded and external subtitles, including tracks extracted from MKV
- Reads tvg-logo and group-title tags from your playlist
- Remembers where you left off

YOUR OWN MEDIA SERVER
- Connect to your own Jellyfin or Emby server
- Browse your libraries, seasons and episodes
- Episodes are sorted automatically and resume where you stopped
- Server addresses and credentials never leave your device

CAR MODE
A landscape layout made for a phone in a dashboard mount: oversized controls, large type, and one-tap switching between entries. Built for passengers.
Note: for passenger use only. Never watch while driving.

MOMENTS WORTH STOPPING FOR
Park by the lake on a quiet weekend, set up your fishing rod, and finally watch that old movie you've been saving. At the campsite, stay curled up with your partner after sunset while you wait for the stars. During a forty-minute charging stop, watch two cartoons with the kids or catch up on that movie you and your friends have talked about for ages. When the car is parked and the big display lights up, an ordinary wait becomes time worth remembering.

MANAGE YOUR PLAYLISTS
- Add as many playlist URLs as you need, by link or by scanning a QR code
- Refresh, rename, or remove any of them
- Filter by the groups in your playlist
- Mark favourites for quick access
- Import video files from your device and play them offline

MINI PLAYER
Keep playing while you browse the rest of your list. No need to back out and start over.

PRIVACY
Everything you add stays on your iPhone. No account needed.

CarTV is a player only. It does not provide, host, bundle, or recommend any content. You supply your own playlists and servers and are responsible for having the right to use them.

name: RailOne
description:
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion. 

Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering  functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.

Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.

Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.

Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.

Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.

Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.

R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.

The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:

Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

name: UMANG
description:
UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is envisaged to make e-governance 'mobile first'. It is developed by Indian Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and National e-Governance Division (NeGD).
                                                                                                     
It is an evolving platform designed for citizens of India to offer them access to the pan-India e-Gov services from the Central, State, Local Bodies, and Agencies of government on app, web, SMS, and IVR channels.
 
Key Features:
- Unified Platform: It brings together all government departments and their services on a single platform to provide better and easier services to citizens.
- Mobile First Strategy: It aligns all government services with the mobile first strategy to leverage mobile adoption trends.    
- Integration with Digital India Services: It provides seamless integration with other Digital India Services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and PayGov. Any new such service will automatically be integrated with the platform.
- Uniform Experience: It is designed to enable citizens to discover, download, access, and use all government services easily.
- Secure and Scalable: It supports Aadhaar-based and other authentication mechanisms for service access. The sensitive profile data is saved in an encrypted format and no one can view this information.               
 
Key Services:
UMANG provides easy access to a plethora of Indian government services ranging from – Healthcare, Finance, Education, Housing, Energy, Agriculture, Transport to even Utility and Employment and Skills.
 
Key Benefits for Citizens:
- Single-Point Ubiquitous Access: All government services are available for citizens on a unified platform for easy access through multiple online and offline channels (SMS, email, app, and web).      
- More for Less: Only a single mobile app needs to be installed instead of each app of each department.
- Convenience: Citizens do not even need to install or update the app again to avail government services if more services are added to the platform.
- Saving of Time and Money: Citizens can anytime and anywhere avail these services through their mobile phones, desktops, and laptops without any need for visiting the department office and standing in queues.
- Uniform Experience: All the government services including payment-based transactions provide secure and uniform experience.

name: Sensi Pro: Sensitivity & HUD
summary: Find, test and share your sensitivity, plus a live game HUD and on-device AI.
description:
Sensi Pro is a sensitivity toolkit for mobile shooter players, with a live Game HUD and on-device AI. No root, no extra apps, no ads.

SENSITIVITY FINDER
• Reads your screen size and refresh rate from the phone itself
• Asks how you hold it (2, 3 or 4 fingers) and how you play
• Suggests starting values and prints every rule it used next to the numbers
Values are a guide you type into your game's own menu. The app never touches a game.

TEST & CALIBRATE
• Three short drills inside the app: flick, track a moving ring, micro-adjust
• Measures overshooting, steadiness and precision, turns them into small per-row adjustments and counts your touch rate
• Shows what changed and why before you apply it

PROFILES & TEMPLATES
• One profile free, three with VIP; every change is saved automatically
• Templates that mirror each game's menu layout: Free Fire-style, PUBG / BGMI-style, COD Mobile-style and a generic shooter layout
• Share a profile as a code or QR code and import a friend's, offline, no account
• VIP: a converter to another template or screen size, and a profile bound to each game

GAME HUD
A floating panel over the games you open from Sensi Pro, with four tabs:
• LIVE: ping, refresh rate (Hz) and battery temperature as gauges with their thresholds
• CHART: your last 60 real ping samples, jitter and the AI's next-ping estimate
• PHONE: Focus, keep awake, dim, screenshot, plus network, thermal status, battery and free RAM
• GAMES: your games one tap away
Outside a game it shrinks to a ping bubble. Hold it still or tap ✕ for the command wheel (finish the session, hide until your next game, switch off), or drag it to the bottom and drop it on a command. Each command has a 3-second undo.

AUTO (VIP)
• Auto HUD: games from your list bring up the HUD however you start them, and it keeps each game's spot. Needs Usage Access, which only tells the app which app is in front. Without VIP, start games from Sensi Pro, its widget or a home-screen shortcut (3 free tries of Auto HUD)
• Auto setup for games started from Sensi Pro: Focus, keep screen on and dim, undone when the HUD closes
• AI alerts when ping or jitter runs above your usual for that game

PRE-GAME
• Device Scan: one tap measures ping, jitter, battery temperature, free RAM and refresh rate. It changes no setting
• Focus Mode: Do Not Disturb for the match, lifted when you return

ON-DEVICE AI
• Network forecast: a small model learns from your real ping history to estimate your next ping
• AI Game Coach: add your games, start them from Sensi Pro and see sessions, play time this week, typical ping and tips per game. Free plan: one game at a time; VIP: every game
Both run entirely on your phone; your ping and play history never leave it.

MORE TOOLS
• GFX Guide: graphics values suggested from your phone's RAM, cores and refresh rates, for you to set in the game
• Home-screen widget and a shortcut per game: one tap starts the game with the HUD
• Session report, weekly play time, break reminder
• English, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, ไทย, Bahasa Melayu, हिन्दी, Português, Español

VIP (optional subscription)
New features first, Auto HUD, AI Game Coach for unlimited games, auto setup, AI alerts, the converter, profiles 2 and 3, screen recording from the HUD and the VIP mailbox to the Sensi team. Prices are shown before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel anytime in Google Play → Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT
Sensi Pro is a configuration and measurement utility. It does NOT read, modify or interact with any game or its files, draws nothing over other apps except the optional Game HUD, injects no code and provides no automatic aiming. Template names only describe each game's own menu layout; game names are trademarks of their owners and this app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game. Some games have their own rules about on-screen overlays; check the rules of the game you play.

name: Game Mode Pro: Launcher & HUD
summary: Launch your games, watch live device readings, get a report after every session.
description:
Game Mode Pro is the paid edition of Game Mode: the same launcher and device-reading tools, its own interface, and no ads of any kind.

GAME LAUNCHER
Your games in one place: games are picked up automatically, anything else you add by hand. A game's home screen shortcut opens it through the app, HUD included, and a widget shows your most played game and the minute it usually dips.

LIVE HUD OVER YOUR GAME
With your permission, a small floating panel shows what Android reports while you play: free RAM, battery level and temperature, latency to a public DNS server, screen refresh rate. It does not show in-game FPS - no app can measure another app's frame rate - and it does not change how your game runs. Games started from the app or its shortcut get the panel; Auto HUD (VIP) opens it however a game starts.

A REPORT AFTER EVERY SESSION
Ping stability, free memory and battery temperature, with the raw numbers beside each score, plus playing time. It also shows what the network did: Wi-Fi signal and band, and the minute the signal went weak, the network changed or dropped, or the phone was moving a lot of data. Every session is kept.

AI GAME COACH - LEARNED FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
A model that runs entirely on your phone reads your recorded sessions: the minute your sessions with a game usually start to wobble, how long the battery lasts at that game's drain, and the time of day and network they held up best on. Two sessions of one game are enough to start. Nothing leaves your phone. These are predictions from your own history, not guarantees.

NETWORK CHECK
Measure: twenty round trips to a public DNS server, with the average, lowest, variation and unanswered samples. Wi-Fi · 4G/5G: both connections measured at the same time, side by side (uses a little mobile data). Regions: time to connect to cloud data centers in 13 regions, to pick a server region in a game's settings. It measures; it cannot change or switch your connection, and never reaches a game's server.

REMINDERS WHILE YOU PLAY
Optional, once per session each: your usual wobble minute, a hot or low battery, a phone already hot on the charger.

GAME MODE
Silences notifications while you play and, if you choose, calls too. It can also hold screen brightness, set media volume, keep the screen awake while Game HUD is on, and remind you to take a break. Give a game its own Game Mode, or skip it for that game. Everything it changes is restored when Game Mode ends; the brightness lock asks for "Modify system settings" first.

TEST KIT
Touch: how often the screen reports your finger, how many fingers it tracks, and a grid showing any spot that never registers. Display: the refresh rate now, the rates the screen supports, and a dead-pixel check. Controller: every button and both sticks, plus a stick-drift check. It only reads what the hardware reports.

REFLEX TRAINER - ROBOT RANGE
Robots pop up at three distances for 30 seconds; tap each before its ring closes. Three ranges open as you rank up, and the lobby replays the best 10 seconds of your record run. Timed from the frame a robot appears to your touch - it measures you, not the device.

GFX GUIDE
From your device's RAM, CPU, resolution and refresh rate, it suggests graphics, frame rate, resolution and shadows to set in the game yourself. It cannot change a game's settings or make it run faster.

VIP (optional subscription)
Auto HUD and Auto Game Mode for games opened from anywhere, plus six things your sessions make possible: a forecast of the next session, battery time left for this game, alerts that learn what is normal for your phone, change since your first sessions, a backup of your session log, and your records with a weekly report. Everything else above is in the purchase price.

10 languages, switchable in the app. "Display over other apps" and "Usage access" are only for the HUD and are asked for on the HUD screen; notification policy access is only for Do Not Disturb.

Accessibility Service API Usage

Searcho includes optional features—Gestures & Screen Lock (navigation
shortcuts, motion gestures, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:

• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding system
actions, such as locking your screen or going Back, Home, Recents, or opening
Notifications and Quick Settings.
• Gesture Context: Reads the active application package name in real-time so
that a gesture performs the correct action for the app currently in the
foreground.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name to
determine which action applies. It does not record keystrokes, personal
details, or other screen content — it is declared without permission to
retrieve window content, so Android itself prevents this.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or transmitted.
All processing happens locally on your device, and Searcho does not hold the
INTERNET permission.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in Android
system settings.

Searcho is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

name: DiskDigger Pro file recovery
summary: Undelete and recover your lost or deleted files with DiskDigger!
description:
DiskDigger Pro (for rooted devices!) can undelete and recover lost photos, documents, videos, music, and more from your memory card or internal memory (see supported file types below). Whether you accidentally deleted a file, or even reformatted your memory card, DiskDigger's powerful data recovery features can find your lost files and let you restore them.

Note: if your device is not rooted, the app can only perform a "limited" scan for for deleted photos and videos. To be able to search for other types of files, and to search your device's entire internal memory, the device needs to be rooted. On a non-rooted device, the app can only recover lower-resolution versions of your photos that it finds in your device's cache and thumbnail directories.

After the scan is complete, tap the "Clean up" button to permanently delete any items that you no longer need (currently an experimental feature, available only in the Basic Scan).

You can also use the "Wipe free space" option to erase the remaining free space on your device, so that any deleted files can no longer be recoverable.

For complete instructions, please see http://diskdigger.org/android

You can upload your recovered files directly to Google Drive, Dropbox, or send them via email. The app also allows you to upload the files to an FTP server, or save them to a different local folder on your device.

DiskDigger can recover the following file types: JPG, PNG, MP4 / 3GP / MOV, M4A, HEIF, GIF, MP3, AMR, WAV, TIF, CR2, SR2, NEF, DCR, PEF, DNG, ORF, DOC / DOCX, XLS / XLSX, PPT / PPTX, PDF, XPS, ODT / ODS / ODP / ODG, ZIP, APK, EPUB, SNB, VCF, RAR, OBML16, OGG, OGA, OGV, OPUS.

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

Organize your game library, monitor real-time device vitals, and minimize distractions with Game Launcher Fire!

Game Launcher Fire is designed as a centralized gaming utility hub. It brings your installed games together in one launcher and provides essential monitoring tools like an in-game HUD, network latency tracking, and a notification silencer for an uninterrupted gaming session.

📊 Real-Time Device & Hardware Monitor

🛡️ In-Game Performance HUD Overlay
• Keep an eye on vital statistics while actively playing.
• Floating HUD overlay displays your ping, memory metrics, and battery temperature directly on your screen.

🔕 Gamer Mode (Do Not Disturb)
• Focus on your gameplay without interruptions.
• Automatically silences notifications and calls using system Do Not Disturb (DND) settings when Gamer Mode is enabled.

🌐 Local Game Firewall (On-Device VPN)
• Limit background data usage of other apps while you game.
• Uses Android's local VpnService to restrict internet access exclusively for unlisted background apps, helping protect your gaming bandwidth.

💡 Real Utility, No False Promises
Tired of generic "game booster" apps that make unrealistic promises about magic RAM cleaners or instant FPS acceleration? Game Launcher Fire takes a realistic, transparent approach. We provide genuine utility tools—like background bandwidth restriction, latency tracking, and notification suppression—giving you full control over your device's actual performance without deceptive claims.

🔒 Permissions & Privacy Transparency
We value your privacy and only request permissions required for core utility features:

• VpnService: Used exclusively to run a local loopback firewall that restricts internet access to unselected background apps. No external VPN server is connected, and no network traffic is logged or sent off your device.
• Notification Policy Access (DND): Required to silence incoming notifications and alerts during Gamer Mode.
• Special Use Foreground Service: Used solely to monitor active network ping and keep the in-game HUD overlay responsive while playing.
• Internet: Used for measuring network latency (ping checks) and serving in-app features.

⚠️ Disclaimer
Game Launcher Fire is a utility and monitoring suite. Unlike misleading "game booster" tools, this app does not overclock, alter, or physically boost device hardware (CPU, GPU, or RAM). Actual gaming performance depends entirely on the hardware specifications provided by your device manufacturer.

Dive into an open world of building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Gather resources, survive the night, and build a world one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a block city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!
 
Craft a new house, build a block city, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream avatar world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer games with friends on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated game 3D world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!
 
BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD
• Build a block city, a house, or create an entire game world from the ground up
• Building simulator games for kids, adults, or anyone
• Craft and build from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Explore an endless open world simulation full of different biomes and creatures
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace
• Private and community servers – Online village building game allows you to connect with millions of players, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server
• Slash commands – Tweak how the 3D game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more
• Add-ons – Block builders can customize their experience even further with add-ons as they build up! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your 3D game to create new resource packs
 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Play with friends and other builders when you join our free massive multiplayer servers
• Multiplayer game servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms through multiplayer games with friends. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you
• Customize your world with Realms Plus. Get instant access to an extensive catalogue that is refreshed every month! Share with friends on your own private Realms server*
• MMO servers allow you to connect and play with players across the world, to explore custom worlds, build with friends, and participate in large-scale events
• Enjoy crafting buildings, building gigantic community-run worlds, competing in unique mini-games, and socializing in lobbies full of fellow Minecraft block builders
 
SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/
 
MINIMUM RECOMMENDED SPECIFICATION
To check the requirements for your device visit: https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409172223501
 
*Realms & Realms Plus: Try a free 30-day trial in-app.

This app uses Accessibility services.
Minecraft includes an Accessibility Service that improves touch interaction when using a screen reader. This service only adjusts touch-passthrough regions — it does not read, log, or transmit your screen content or personal data.

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
summary: Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet.
description:
Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features:  
• Remastered, high-resolution graphics built specifically for mobile including lighting enhancements, an enriched color palette and improved character models. 
• Cloud save support for playing across all your mobile devices for Rockstar Social Club Members.
• Dual analog stick controls for full camera and movement control.
• Three different control schemes and customizable controls with contextual options to display buttons only when you need them.
• Compatible with the MoGa Wireless Game Controllers and select Bluetooth and USB gamepads.
• Integrated with Immersion tactile effects.  
• Tailor your visual experience with adjustable graphic settings. 

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese.

name: Hitman Sniper
summary: ANSWER THE SNIPER CALL
description:
Step into the shoes of Agent 47 in Hitman Sniper and play the best sniper shooting game on mobile.

PLAY A TACTICAL SNIPER MISSION GAME
Strike with strategic shooting skills, fulfilling your duty to orchestrate the perfect assassination kill shot.


BATTLE ZOMBIES IN DEATH VALLEY
Call on non-stop shooting action as a zombie hunter, in a true battle of your skills and speed of execution.

150+ MISSIONS & 10 DIFFERENT CONTRACTS
Improve your strike skills on mobile for the perfect assassination as you uncover secrets and subterfuges in this fun game.

MOST BEAUTIFUL SNIPER GAME

PLAY WITH 16 UNIQUE GUNS

Boost your score and climb up the contract killer ranks classic with classic creative hitman kills to become the world's finest silent assassin.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
summary: Fly around the world! Pilot 3D airplanes and land at airports in this live sim!
description:
Your Ultimate Flight Simulation Experience on Mobile! Discover the thrill of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator, the most advanced flight simulation for mobile.

Whether you are a pro pilot or starting your journey into airplane games, RFS offers the most comprehensive experience. Pilot iconic aircraft, access global flights in real time, and explore ultra-realistic airports with live weather. This is the ultimate simulator for fans of plane games and flight simulation games.

Fly Anywhere in the World!
Take off from any part of the globe. Our flight simulator uses high-res satellite maps and 3D plane models to create a living world. Experience the unique sensation of being an airplane pilot as you navigate realistic topography. Fly through the world and explore detailed landmarks in your favorite 3D airplane.

60+ Aircraft Models – Take control of commercial, cargo, and military jets. From narrow-body airliners to massive jumbo planes, each aircraft features 3D live cockpits, FMC, and realistic lighting. New airplanes and planes are added regularly to our fleet!

1900+ HD Airports – Land your plane at detailed 3D airports with jetways and authentic taxiway procedures. Navigate busy terminals like a real pilot. Ground services include pushback, refueling, and catering for a complete airline experience.

Realistic Satellite Terrain – Fly over high-fidelity landscapes. Our technology provides accurate elevation data for every mountain and valley. Experience the most advanced landing simulator on mobile. Perfect for fans of realistic flight simulator gameplay.

Autopilot & Advanced Planning – Plan long-haul flights with precise autopilot, VNAV, LNAV, and ILS landing assistance. Customize weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots and explore the global aviation network.

Real Pilot Checklists – Master every stage of the flight. Follow authentic takeoff and landing procedures for total immersion in your pilot simulator. Use real-world protocols for every flight and plane mission.

Live Global Flights – Experience the world in real-time! Track over 40,000 real-time flights daily at major hubs world-wide. See live air traffic and join a living global flight network.

Join a Global Aviation Community!
RFS is more than just a flight game; it’s a living community.

• Fly with hundreds of aviators in real-time multiplayer modes.
• Chat with fellow pilots in the cockpit or global frequency.
• Join a Virtual Airline (VA) and compete in the leaderboards.

ATC Mode: Take Control of the Skies!
Become an Air Traffic Controller! 

• Manage live air traffic in our dedicated ATC game mode.
• Issue instructions, guide planes to the runway, and ensure safe navigation.
• Experience high-fidelity multi-voice ATC communications.

Create and Share Your Passion!

• Customize Your Plane: Design custom airplane liveries and share them globally.
• Design Your Airport: Build your own HD airport and watch the community take off.
• Plane Spotter Mode: Capture 3D screenshots and share with airplane game fans.
• Dynamic Environment: Experience stunning sunrise and sunsets in highest fidelity.

Technical Sim Features:

• Multi-panel instruments for advanced avionics.
• Realistic 3D spatial audio and real-time weather.
• Complex failure simulation including engines and gear.
• Weight and balance for realistic flight physics.

An Internet connection is required for real-time simulation and multiplayer.
Some features and airplanes require a subscription.

Get Ready to Soar!
Buckle up, push the throttle, and become a Real Pilot in RFS!

Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Earn to Die
summary: Can you survive the zombie apocalypse? Choose your car and smash those zombies!
description:
Drive your way through a zombie apocalypse!

Are you ready to drive for your life? The hit online game series that has enjoyed OVER 200 MILLION PLAYS has been revamped and re-engineered for your mobile and tablet, bigger and better than ever before!

You're stranded in a desert surrounded by zombies. With only a run-down car and a small amount of cash at your disposal, your mission soon becomes clear – to drive through hordes of zombies in order to escape... alive!


THE BEST OF THE ACTION, DRIVING AND UPGRADE GENRES
Earn to Die sees you not only driving your way through hordes of zombies, but allows you to earn cash to upgrade, unlock and customise new vehicles. Is your vehicle not strong enough? Why not add a gun, or boosters, or even a spiked frame?



Key Features
● A brand new and extended STORY MODE which sees you driving cross-country during a zombie apocalypse
● 8 VEHICLES at your disposal, including a race-car, a truck and even a school bus!
● UPGRADES GALORE! Just unlocking a vehicle isn't enough, customise each vehicle with a range of upgrades
● Zombiesssssssssssss... Plenty of zombies... Be sure to introduce them to your car's front bumper
● A realistic ragdoll physics engine that allows you to crash into zombies and send them flying!
● Awesome animated sequences
● Race for the best time in Championship Mode
● Survived the zombie apocalypse? Smash through pumpkins in Halloween Mode



With over 200 Million Plays to the original online version, be one of the first to download the extended, BIGGER and BETTER version for your Android device.

name: Driving Zone: Germany Pro
summary: Driving simulator with German cars. Racing car games without ads and limits.
description:
Driving Zone: Germany Pro – the premium version of the popular car game and street racing simulator, without ads or limitations. Experience the thrill of driving legendary German cars with ultra-realistic physics and graphics.

Pro Version Features:
- 20,000 bonus coins.
- Completely ad-free. Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with no distractions.
- Free driving mode. Your car will never break down, allowing you to enjoy endless driving fun.
- Unified cloud save and progress synchronization with the free version of the game.

Explore a variety of game modes:
- Career Mode: Complete exciting missions like parking challenges, time-based races, overtaking in traffic, and long-distance driving.
- Driving School: Master essential driving skills in a test environment, navigating cones and learning advanced techniques.
- Street Racing: Compete on highways, city streets, or icy winter tracks with dynamic weather changes.
- Drift Mode: Perfect your drifting skills on sharp turns and earn points for style and precision.
- Drag Racing: Compete in high-speed, straight-line races on a 402-meter drag track.
- Replay Mode: Relive your best races and improve your strategy with cinematic replays.

Enhanced Tracks and Features:
The Pro version features many unique tracks, including:
- Bavarian Alps: Drive through challenging mountain roads with breathtaking views.
- Test Track: Learn driving mechanics in a controlled environment.
- Highway and city streets: Enjoy day or night drive on roads with dense traffic.
- Drag Strip: Push your car’s speed to the limit in drag races.

Additional Features:
- High-quality 3D graphics and ultra realistic car physics.
- Prototypes of legendary german cars with customization and tuning options.
- Dynamic day-night cycles and weather changes.
- Multiple camera angles: first-person, interior, cinematic views.
- Automatic cloud save for seamless progress syncing.

Start your engines and embark on the ultimate driving adventure without limits. Customize your car, master challenging tracks, and explore diverse gameplay modes in a premium, distraction-free experience.

Warning! This game is highly realistic, but it is not intended to teach or encourage street racing. Please drive carefully and responsibly in real life. Enjoy virtual driving in dense traffic, but always follow traffic rules and stay safe on real roads.

name: Shadow Knight: Ninja Fighting
summary: A Legendary Action RPG With Ninja Shadow Legends Fighting Style Offline Games!
description:
Hot Sale is here! Hurry up and get the most stunning items and unique skins for free to equip your unique hero and fight to become Shadow Legends.

The beautiful and brightly world of Harmonia was a land to live of Mortal races including Human, Undead, Orc, Spirit, Dwarf, Beast man, Elf, etc. But then one day, when deep desires arose, a tragedy struck that made everything in vain darkness, irony just because of a Guilty Favor.

To save the world of Harmonia from the shadow wars, as a Shadow Knight Premium, battle epic monsters, fight evil enemies to defeat the immortals of Darkness and bring back the light to Harmonia. Will you be that forceful Shadow Knight Premium?

Download and Join the fight now!

GAME FEATURES:

▶ Extreme Game Feeling
Experience the action rpg game feeling with hack and slash gameplay in dark fantasy world setting. Explore many types of complex terrain by running, climbing, jumping, there're fascinating mystery points for you to find out!

▶ Adventure Fantasy Story
You will be immersed in endless dark fantasy shadow battles. Adventure towns, forests, dungeons,... while entering a fantasy world full of monsters, zombies, skeletons, orcs and undead creatures. Defeat ultimate enemies, powerful bosses to change the fate of world!

Collect the best weapon, equipment, rune from hundreds of items, then fully customize your Shadow Knight to stand out from other knights. Join the adventure and create craziest combats 'cause Your Knight, Your Style!

name: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redu
summary: Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux - Post-Apocalyptic Action Shooter
description:
Survive deadly combat and stealth in the poisoned wasteland of Chernobyl Zone. Play as Serioga, lead your people to safety in the old subway tunnels, and fight for survival in this immersive post-apocalyptic world.

Long Description:

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is an epic, story-driven first person post-apocalyptic shooter from AGaming+. In 2014, an apocalypse destroyed most of humanity and turned the Earth's surface into a poisoned wasteland. It's now 2034, and as the surface of the Earth freezes, people must seek shelter in the old subway tunnels.

You play as Serioga, a survivor born just before the apocalypse, who must lead your people to safety and fight for survival against terrifying enemies. Explore the dangerous world, scavenge for resources, and engage in deadly combat and stealth.

Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux is one of the most immersive game worlds ever created, with stunning graphics and realistic sound effects. Can you survive and lead your people to safety? Play Z.O.N.A Shadow of Limansk Redux now and find out.

name: The Sun Origin Post Apocalypse
summary: Post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG.
description:
Autumn sale: Save 75% on The Sun: Origin!

The Sun: Origin is a post-apocalyptic action-shooter RPG that will challenge you to survive in a harsh and unforgiving world. Explore the wastelands, build your character, and fight for your life against mutants, bandits, and other survivors.

Key Features:

* Explore a vast and dangerous world: The wastelands are full of resources and dangers. Explore every corner of the map to find valuable loot, but be prepared to fight for it.
* Build your character: Choose from a variety of classes and customize your character's skills and abilities. Level up your character and become stronger as you progress through the game.
* Fight for your survival: The wastelands are full of enemies, both human and mutant. Fight for your life against bandits, raiders, and even other survivors.
* Craft your gear: Use the resources you find in the wastelands to craft weapons, armor, and other equipment. Build the best gear you can to survive in this harsh world.

The Sun: Origin is a challenging game, but it is also a rewarding one. If you are up for the challenge, then this game is for you.

Download The Sun: Origin today and experience the post-apocalyptic wasteland for yourself!

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City
summary: Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.
description:
Welcome back to Vice City. Welcome back to the 1980s.

From the decade of big hair, excess and pastel suits comes a story of one man's rise to the top of the criminal pile. Vice City, a huge urban sprawl ranging from the beach to the swamps and the glitz to the ghetto, was one of the most varied, complete and alive digital cities ever created. Combining open-world gameplay with a character driven narrative, you arrive in a town brimming with delights and degradation and given the opportunity to take it over as you choose. 

To celebrate its 10 year anniversary, Rockstar Games brings Grand Theft Auto: Vice City to mobile devices with high-resolution graphics, updated controls and a host of new features including: 

• Beautifully updated graphics, character models and lighting effects 
• New, precisely tailored firing and targeting options 
• Custom controls with a fully customizable layout 
• Massive campaign with countless hours of gameplay
• Compatible with the MoGa Wireless Game Controller and select USB gamepads

name: Survival Island: Evolve Pro
summary: Survival has become even more difficult, dangerous and exciting!
description:
Many centuries have passed before the humanity has finally achieved its long awaited goal – we have conquered the Earth and enslaved the nature forces. But you know how they say, the bigger they are – the harder they fall. Eventually we did fall and it was hard. Environmental cataclysm exploded, covering every major city in toxic smog, the atmosphere became less and less livable with each passing day, the Earth’s light started to decay. The only way of delaying the inevitable turned out to be a special emulsion obtained out of the rarest metal Pridium. The Earth Protection Committee formed a special task force in order to discover new worlds rich in Pridium. You stepped up as a volunteer and departed for the unexplored territory but as it usually happens, something went wrong. You woke up on an island with no team, no water or food, no clothes and only with a dull head and a heap of questions. You must survive by all means and get back home. It won’t be easy so get going and good luck!

Game features:
* Explore the wilderness! 
* Build your house from the ground up!
* Utilize an extensive crafting system with tons of recipes
* Meet the island fauna! 
* Island survival sandbox simulator

name: Tomb Raider™
summary: Lara Croft’s complete origin adventure, expertly adapted for Android.
description:
Before there was the Tomb Raider, there was Lara Croft; twenty-one years old and shipwrecked on her first archaeological expedition. To escape the mysterious isle of Yamatai, she must push far beyond her limits, leave innocence behind and be reborn a legend.

Explore Yamatai’s ancient ruins, unlock its riddles and fight for survival against its murderous inhabitants. 

Tomb Raider for Android is the complete adventure, expertly adapted for mobile. Play it your way, whether using intuitive touchscreen controls, mouse & keyboard, or your favourite gamepad.

TOMB RAIDER COMPLETE AND UNCUT
Lara’s first AAA outing on Android arrives without compromise — packed with exploration, intense firefights, puzzles and Challenge Tombs.

OVERCOME THE ODDS
Unlock skills, hunt for materials, and craft equipment to take Lara from desperate survivor to master adventurer.

UNCOVER A LOST KINGDOM
Discover lost relics and ancient scrolls to unravel the mysteries of Yamatai and the cultists who prowl its depths.

INCLUDES BONUS CONTENT
Tomb Raider for Android comes with 12 DLC packs, including Skills, Weapon Upgrades and a variety of skins for Lara, plus a bonus Challenge Tomb.

TAILORED TO ANDROID
Includes gyroscopic motion-aim on supported devices, as well as optimisation presets for improved performance or visuals.

===

name: Bike Mayhem Mountain Racing
summary: Rip down tons of mountains while busting tricks on your custom bike!
description:
Downhill mountain bike racing like never before. Race down beautiful trails, smashing over rocks and roots, boosting huge jumps, scoring insane trick combos, unlocking better bikes and gear for bragging rights as the King of the Mountain!

The best mobile bike game, Bike Mayhem Extreme Mountain Racing! 

Compete in timed races or freestyle trick events on 19 different mountains and over 100 trails inspired by real world locations.

Unlock over 80 items of gear to add style your rider and tune your bike for speed, agility, strength, and energy for each trail.

Experience realistic physics and plush bike suspension as your bike eats up the rough stuff and softens the landings of big jumps and drops. 
High speeds and big jumps means huge crashes where your rider will ragdoll tumble down the trail. Use your finger to pick up you rider throw him even further.

Share your races with your friends. Challenge them to beat your times! 

Brought to you by the makers of the epically popular Motocross racing game: Moto X Mayhem, which reached #1 Paid App worldwide and was a Top 5 Racing game for over a year! 

FEATURES: 

- 100+ Beautiful mountain trails for all styles of riding
- 80+ Gear items for your rider and MTB bike 
- Frame and wheel upgrades that impact game play
- Epic bike crashes, fun rag doll physics and active bike suspension
- Tricks, bunny hops and flips! 
- Addictive gameplay 
- Powerful online leaderboards

TIPS: 

- If you use check points, you will get a maximum of one star. Stay on your bike to achieve 3 stars! 
- Lean to add flips into your trick combo. 
- Wheelie into and out of a jump to add to your trick combo.
- Hold down the pump/hop button when entering a downhill section to get a boost in speed.
- Wheelies do not drain your energy
- The timer doesn't start until you start to pedal the bike or brake! 
- Use your finger to grab the rider and toss him around the map when you're on or off the bike. 
- Make sure you pick the right frame and wheel combination to get the best score for each trail.
-Use boosters to help you through a difficult trail or to get the top position on the leaderboard.

name: Hitman: Absolution
summary: Plan. Adapt. Assassinate.
description:
CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

===

Branded a traitor and hunted by the Agency he once served, Agent 47 returns to Android in Hitman: Absolution.

Stalk your targets through elaborate environments that reward both quick thinking and patient planning. Strike silently from the shadows, or let your silverballers do the talking — whatever your approach, each of Absolution’s 20 missions is a contract killer’s happy hunting ground.

Expertly adapted for mobile play, Absolution’s sleek touchscreen controls offer 47’s hallmark precision, with gamepad and keyboard & mouse support included for the full AAA experience on the go.

SIGNATURE STYLE
Blend into the background, kill silently and disappear without trace, or go in all guns blazing! Absolution’s missions invite you to experiment, improvise and perfect your technique.

COMPLETE CONTROL
Customise touch controls until they fit you like a glove, or connect a gamepad or any Android-compatible keyboard & mouse.

MORE THAN A NUMBER
The story of Absolution puts Agent 47’s character under the spotlight, where both his loyalties and his conscience are put to the test.

KILLER INSTINCT
Use Instinct Mode to identify targets, predict enemy movement, and highlight points of interest.

CLEAR YOUR PATH
Use Point Shooting to stop time, mark multiple enemies, and eliminate them in a heartbeat.

MASTER THE CRAFT
Find new ways to take out your marks, complete Challenges, or take the ultimate test in Purist mode, with deadlier enemies and no help to guide you.

CONTRACTS MODE
Hitman’s unlimited sandbox mode — take on player-designed contracts from other agents around the world, or create and share your own.

Drive powerful cargo trucks across highways, cities, mountains, and country roads while delivering freight safely to different destinations. Complete transport missions, earn rewards, unlock better trucks, and enjoy a relaxing driving experience.

Experience smooth controls, detailed environments, changing weather, and realistic truck physics.
